text: SELECT activities.activity_id, activities.molregno, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE activities.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613836')
